title: SIDESTORY: DOROTHY'S VISION RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: DOROTHY'S VISION RERUN
DURATION: March 5, 2024, 10:00 - March 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Dorothy's Vision event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Research Base] Duration: March 5, 2024, 10:00 - March 15, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Rhine Headquarters] Duration: March 5, 2024, 10:00 - March 15, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Data Collection]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Data Collection] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARD: [★★★★★: Astgenne], Rhine Experimental Culture Pod Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, [Mysterious Reagents], etc.
[Laboratory Recycling Depot]
DURATION: March 5, 2024, 10:00 - March 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Mysterious Reagents] by clearing event stages and completing [Data Collection] missions. [Mysterious Reagents] can be used to redeem items from [Laboratory Recycling Depot].
REWARD: Astgenne's token, Rhine Experimental Culture Pod Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

- The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
- Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
- This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

- The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
- Items in the Intelligence Certification Area will have the available purchase amount increased on top of the existing amount and have new items added when event reruns begin.
- Operators Dorothy, Astgenne, and Greyy the Lightningbearer will gain more trust during the event rerun.
- After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Side Story] permanently from March 19, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – PATHFINDER OF SANDS
DURATION: March 5, 2024, 10:00 - March 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Pathfinder of Sands], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting
★★★★★★: Dorothy
★★★★★: Greyy the Lightningbearer / Rockrock

NOTE: This is a [Standard Headhunting], and the operators available will be consistent with the latest permanent [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: March 5, 2024, 10:00 - March 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Her Aspiration for Astgenne
04 CORAL COAST COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: March 5, 2024, 10:00 - March 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
MARTHE [Coral Coast] - Shimmering Dew SD08 for Carnelian
MARTHE [Coral Coast] - Casual Vacation HDm04 for Flamebringer
MARTHE [Coral Coast] - Summer Flower FA641 for Blacknight
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET RHINE EXPERIMENTAL CULTURE POD
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Dorothy's Vision event rewards and redeem in Laboratory Recycling Depot (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
06 ICEFIELD SURVEY PACK AND HURRICANE CHASING PACK AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DURATION: March 5, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
Icefield Survey Pack
CONTENTS: Orundum * 2000, Nucleic Crystal Sinter * 2, Crystalline Electronic Unit * 2, Refined Solvent * 2, Integrated Device * 10
Hurricane Chasing Pack
CONTENTS: Orundum * 4500, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1
Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter: You can promote a hired ★5 Operator to Elite 2 Lv.1 (effective for Operators under Elite 2 Lv.1). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
07 MOONLIGHT INVITE LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: March 5, 2024, 04:00 – March 19, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event period, players can participate in three steps of mooncake making: Crust Dough Kneading, Filling Mixing, and Mooncake Making on the first 3 days of the event sign-in. By doing so, player can obtain a mooncake with specific style (which provides 120 Sanity when used) and Exclusive Furniture. After signing in for 10 days, there are also rewards like Orundum, Module Materials, Battle Records and more.
Day 1-Crust Dough Kneading: Chip Catalyst * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2-Filling Mixing: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3-Mooncake Making: Exclusive Furniture*1, Mooncake (provides 120 Sanity when used)
Day 4: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Skill Summary - 1 * 30
Day 5: Orundum * 200, Furniture Part * 300
Day 6: Skill Summary - 2 * 20, Pure Gold * 20
Day 7: Skill Summary - 3 * 8, Strategic Battle Record * 10
Day 8: Orundum * 200, LMD * 30000
Day 9: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 10: Module Data Block * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Note :
- The expiration date of the Mooncake obtained in this sign-in event should be based on the display within the game.
- In this event, players can only obtain the mooncake and furniture corresponding to the selected mooncake style. Unselected mooncake and furniture will not be available.
Please stay tuned for more information!
